jobs.title: Security Officer – Corporate Lobby Desk
jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer – Corporate Lobby Desk in Chicago, IL, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Commercial Real Estate, and more. As a Front Desk Officer at a commercial real estate location, you will welcome tenants and visitors, support lobby operations, monitor entry points and cameras, manage visitor logs and badges, and respond to alarms and security-related concerns with clear communication. You will represent Allied Universal with a people-first approach, staying agile and reliable while partnering with the site team to help maintain an orderly, professional environment.

Position Type: Full Time

Pay Rate: $23.50 / Hour

Job Schedule:

DayTimeMon07:00 AM – 03:00 PMTue07:00 AM – 03:00 PMWed07:00 AM – 03:00 PMSat07:00 AM – 03:00 PMSun07:00 AM – 03:00 PM

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide customer service to tenants, visitors, and vendors at the front desk by following Allied Universal security-related procedures and site-specific policies.
  • Control access to the property by greeting and directing guests, verifying identification and/or credentials, issuing visitor passes, and maintaining visitor logs.
  • Monitor and acknowledge alarms, cameras, and other building systems from the front desk, and report irregular activity according to post orders.
  • Respond to incidents and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, including contacting emergency services and/or property management as directed.
  • Complete required documentation such as incident reports, access logs, and shift activity reports, and communicate pertinent information during shift turnovers.

Minimum Requirements

  • Client requires proof of high school diploma and/or GED.
  • Alarm panel experience is preferred.
  • Access control and/or badge experience is preferred.
  • CPR certification is preferred.A guard card and/or license is preferred.
  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21 years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law. For more information: www.aus.com.

jobs.title: Corporate Security Protection Officer
jobs.description:
Location: Chicago, IL (downtown)

Schedule: Onsite | Full-Time

Position Summary

Our client, a leading financial services organization, is seeking a Corporate Security Protection Officer to provide a visible security presence and ensure the safety of employees, clients, and visitors within a corporate banking environment. This is a professional, client-facing position requiring strong communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to respond effectively to dynamic situations while maintaining a polished appearance and professional demeanor.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain a visible security presence throughout corporate banking facilities.
  • Conduct routine patrols of offices, common areas, and secured locations.
  • Monitor access points and address unauthorized access, tailgating, or security violations.
  • Assess potential threats and respond appropriately to safety and security incidents.
  • Serve as a point of contact for employees, clients, guests, and visitors regarding security concerns.
  • Investigate suspicious activity and escalate incidents as necessary.
  • Support emergency response procedures and maintain situational awareness at all times.
  • Provide a reassuring and professional presence while helping deter disruptive behavior.
  • Ensure compliance with company security policies, procedures, and safety standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Must possess and maintain a personally owned firearm and be able to legally carry and conceal while on duty.
  • Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to remain alert, mobile, and actively patrol throughout the workday.
  • Professional appearance and ability to work in a business attire environment.

Schedule

  • 8-hour shifts with rotating schedules
  • Shift rotation occurs approximately every 4 weeks

Typical shift options include:

  • 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM
  • 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM
  • 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM
  • 1:00 PM – 9:30 PM
  • No weekends
  • No holidays
  • Overtime available and paid when required

Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Paid Time Off, and additional employee benefit offerings available.

If interested in more details, please apply!

Salary: USD 60000 - 80000 per year

jobs.title: Armed Security Officer- 1st Shift
jobs.description:
Job Description

As an S&C Electric team member, you’ll work on projects that have real-world impact. You’ll help transform the grid for resilient and reliable power worldwide. S&C has more than a 100-year history of innovation and has been 100% employee-owned since 2012. We continue this legacy as a trusted, forward-thinking leader in the electrical industry. You will advance a safer, more reliable, and more resilient electrical grid. Our products help the grid adapt to severe weather and transition to clean energy. We’re big enough to be a respected industry leader but small enough for you to impact our company directly. Our commitment gives you opportunities to impact on and off the job positively.

Join S&C to make an impact on tomorrow’s energy challenges and become an employee-owner!

Hours

  • 8:00 am – 4:30 pm

Compensation

At S&C, we are dedicated to providing competitive and equitable compensation for all our team members, and we are committed to transparency in our pay practices. The estimated annual base salary range for this position is $49,040 - $61,300. Individual pay within this salary range is determined by several compensable factors, including performance, knowledge, job-related skills and experience, and relevant education or training. This role is also eligible for S&C’s annual incentive plan (AIP), subject to eligibility criteria.

Join Our Team as a Security Officer!

S&C Electric Company is seeking a dynamic individual to coordinate our security function. As a Security Officer, you’ll be crucial in ensuring smooth operations and supporting our diverse team. Officers perform duties in three main categories, including patrolling the S&C Ridge Boulevard Industrial Campus facility, working in the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC), and operating the security gatehouses.

Key Responsibilities

  • Utilize strong, written communication skills by creating clear and accurate incident and field activity reports in a timely manner.
  • Conduct and document events/ investigations with close attention to detail; gather and summarize statements and facts for records.
  • Perform routine and scheduled patrols of the S&C Campus to: regulate traffic and parking, ensure team member safety, respond to emergencies/incidents.
  • Act as first responders to critical and emergent situations including: medical emergencies, fires, hazardous material releases/spills, unauthorized personnel on campus, confined space rescues, severe weather, and building evacuations.
  • Certify and maintain required certification in the use of self-contained breathing apparatus and/or respirators.
  • Monitor fire, building supervisory, high-voltage supply, intrusion alarm, and closed-circuit video systems while assigned to the Global Security Operations Center (GSOC).
  • Monitor entry/exit and access to S&C Campus, with attention to detail for guiding team members, vehicles, visitors, and contractors. Maintain accurate logs and records of all commercial-related entrants.
  • Issue temporary identification badges and parking permits to authorized individuals.
  • Coordinate logistics of commercial deliveries and shipments from the GSOC.
  • Operate communication systems by serving as radio dispatchers and telephone switchboard operators during off-hours.
  • Directly identifying and addressing safety, trespassing and workplace violence concerns, which may include, but is not limited to, the detaining of threatening individuals for police resolution.
  • Safely remove unauthorized individuals from the campus using various de-escalation techniques.
  • Maintaining licensing and certifications for essential training and equipment necessary to perform job duties. (PERC, FOID, DL)
  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance.
  • Attend in-person or virtual meetings as requested or required.
  • Communicate effectively and respectfully with others.
  • Drive a car or other vehicle.
  • Understand and comply with all applicable Company policies and rules.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • High School diploma or acceptable General Educational Development (GED), some college preferred.
  • Illinois Driver’s License and Illinois Firearms Owner’s Identification Card.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills; proficiency with personal computers.
  • State of Illinois Security Officer 40-Hour Training Program for armed security
  • A Permanent Employee Registration Card (PERC) and ability to successfully obtain the Firearm Authorization Card (FAC) issued from the State of Illinois, Department of Financial and Professional Regulation.
  • 4 years of security or related background. Industrial security, law enforcement, or military experience preferred.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong computer and technological skills
  • Conflict resolution skills
  • De-escalation and high stress management skills
  • Understanding laws and regulations pertaining to armed security work
  • Understanding signals of distress or impairment in others

Preferred

  • Associates Degree in Security, Criminal Justice, Law Enforcement, or related field.
  • Any advanced National Incident Management System (NIMS) training.
  • Handcuffing certification.
  • De-escalation training i.e., Crisis Prevention Institute (CPI) or Crisis Intervention (CIT) Training certifications

Major Physical Demands

  • Frequently required to stand and perform tasks for 2-4 hours at a time approximately [5] days per work week.
  • Frequently required to remain in a stationary position and perform desk-based for 2-4 hours at a time approximately [5] days per work week.
  • Frequently required to walk moderate distances up to [1-2 miles on campus while patrolling] [frequency – e.g., multiple times each day]
  • Occasionally required to solo lift and/or carry items ranging in weight from 5 to 40 lb, and team lift and carry items or other team members to safety, exercising sound judgment to employ manual handling or machine lifts where required and risk assessments, if appropriate.
  • Occasionally required to position self to perform tasks involving but not limited to reaching, twisting, rotating, and pushing/pulling.
  • Occasionally required to use hand-eye coordination to control both hands and arms for a full range of motion to operate equipment/machinery/power tools/office productivity equipment.
  • Frequently ascending or descending ladders/stairs/scaffolding/ramps/poles.
  • Frequently required to observe details at close range, including depth perception, peripheral vision, and the ability to differentiate between colors.
  • Continuously required to talk and hear in person and by phone/conference calls.
  • Frequently required to travel (up to 10%) and work extended hours when necessary.

S&C Electric is committed to equal-opportunity employment. All employees and applicants will be considered without regard to age, color, disability, gender, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, protected veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation to complete the application, please email us at TAsupport@sandc.com .

MUST HAVE VALID PERC CARD, MINIMUM 20 HOUR TRAINING AND PREVIOUS EVENT SECURITY EXPERIENCE. RELIABLE TRANSPORTATION NEEDED DUE TO LOCATIONS.
Job Summary:
Provide security detail as outlined in the post orders and establish working relationships with customers, local law enforcement and fire departments. Security personnel will always perform job duties with a constant awareness of surroundings, making note of all activity that takes place in the assigned area. Security Officers must maintain a professional image and always demonstrate excellent customer service.

Basic Functions:
  • Control of entrances and movement of pedestrian and vehicle traffic.
  • Patrol of buildings and perimeters.
  • Escort of material and personnel.
  • Inspection of security and fire exposures.
  • Special assignments.
Responsibilities:
Duties may vary depending on department size, organizational structure, geographic location and post assignments. Reasonable accommodations may be made to allow for certain ADA requirements. Overall general function of officers is to provide security detail as described below (Note: duties may vary depending on post orders):
  • Be on time and report to post in full uniform.
  • Maintain professional image that includes greeting customers, visitors and employees in a polite and friendly manner.
  • Be proactive in knowing all revisions to post orders and general information distributed by the customer and AFS.
  • Patrol physical property or maintain fixed post position, being diligent to report any suspicious activity and investigate accidents and criminal acts.
  • Monitor cameras or equipment in a continuous fashion as outlined in the post orders.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of all emergency policies, procedures and regulations to be able to respond to alarms, incidents and emergency situations.
  • Complete Daily Activity Reports, Log Book entries, Incident Reports and all relevant reports related to job assignment.
  • Make recommendations to management on better safety and loss prevention processes as identified during daily routine.
  • Have knowledge of any life safety systems, fire panels, CCTV system computer, and other such equipment to complete job assignments. Ensure continuous and safe operation of all elevators and access doors. Know authorized contractor personnel who are responsible for maintenance and upkeep of equipment.
  • Ensure training and compliance guidelines are met as outlined by AFS and other agencies regulating the customer / market.

  • Ability to facilitate progressive change, work as part of a team and follow directions.
